rules.name: Outside the limits
rules.text: One day above the upper limit (or below the lower one). Something was different that day: find it while people still remember.

rules.name: Shift
rules.text: Eight days or more in a row on the same side of the centre line. The process has moved: after a change you made, that is proof it worked; without one, find what changed.

rules.name: Trend
rules.text: Six days or more in a row, each higher (or each lower) than the one before. Something is drifting: wear, backlog, staffing or a slow change in volume.

verdicts.stable: No signals. The ups and downs are the normal noise of this process. Reacting to single days will not help and may make it worse: to get a better number, change the process itself.
verdicts.badSpecial: The chart shows days that are not normal noise. Investigate those days first: what was different in volume, people, equipment or method?
verdicts.goodSpecial: The chart shows a lasting improvement. Find out what made the difference and make it the standard, then recalculate the limits from the new level.
verdicts.short: Fewer than 12 days in the chart. The limits are rough; keep adding days before you trust a signal.
